item.title: Apple's 'Welcome Home' event is Tuesday: new Home Hub, HomePod Mini 2, Apple TV 4K expected
item.description:
MacRumors reports Apple will unveil an all-new Home Hub device on October 13, alongside a HomePod Mini 2 with new features and a long-awaited new Apple TV 4K. Six Colors asks the bigger question — whether Apple is 'coming home to stay' with a renewed smart-home push. MacRumors' Top Stories roundup has the full pre-event briefing.

Sources:

  • Apple's All-New Home Hub Will Be Revealed October 13: What to Expect
  • Apple Announcing HomePod Mini 2 Next Week With These New Features
  • A New Apple TV 4K is Finally Coming on Tuesday
  • Is Apple coming home to stay?
  • Top Stories: Apple's 'Welcome Home' Launch on October 13 and More

item.title: Amazon's new Alexa Tablet finally gives the iPad real competition
item.description:
9to5Mac argues Amazon's new Alexa Tablet is the first credible iPad challenger in years, with an aggressive price and an Alexa-first experience that could pressure Apple's lineup from below.

item.title: iPhone Duo greets owners by name; 30 old Mac minis outmuscle a Cray-1
item.description:
AppleInsider notes the iPhone Duo will greet some owners by name on first boot — a small personal touch. In computing history fun, 30 old Intel Mac minis housed in a Cray-1 chassis are hugely faster than the supercomputer they live in. Also: 9to5Mac on remote AppleCare log collection in macOS 27, and MacRumors' AirPods 5 buyer's guide.
